prompt: A product design presentation board on a plain very light celeste-white background: exactly three tall portrait smartphone screens standing side by side at equal size, flat screens with thin rounded outlines and no hands, each with a small tracked caption above it: 01 CAPTURE, 02 CROSS-CHECK WITH NASA DATA, 03 PRE-DIAGNOSIS. The app is Field Shift, a crop-rotation and pest pre-diagnosis app for small farmers, English UI text. Type: Source Serif 4 regular for large figures and titles; Source Sans 3 uppercase with wide tracking for small labels. Light daylight theme: white and pale celeste, generous whitespace, 1px hairline rules, sunrise amber used only for warnings and key figures. Each screen calm and uncluttered. No NASA logo, no flags, no mission patches, no people. World: full-screen vertical feed, one finding per screen over field imagery, with a right rail of round outline icon buttons. Screen 01 CAPTURE: a consultant chat. Top: a small map chip showing a drawn field polygon labeled 2.1 ha · Huaral, Peru and a two-way switch My GPS | Example site. A consultant message: What are you growing now, and what grew here before? The farmer replies: Peas now. Lettuce before. A row of four photo thumbnails of green pea plants, one marked blurry. The consultant replies: Thanks. Photo 3 is blurry. Take the underside of a leaf, closer. Bottom: a camera button and a text field Up to 10 photos. Screen 02 CROSS-CHECK WITH NASA DATA: a full-bleed close aerial image of the pea field in morning light with a white sky scrim at the bottom; story progress segments at the top (six, three filled, labeled Temperature, Moisture, Rain, Vigor, Slope, 2040); lower left the current card: tracked label SOIL MOISTURE · SMAP, large serif reading Drier than normal, a line Your photos show yellowing lower leaves. Both point to water stress., a small badge PHOTO + SATELLITE AGREE, source line NASA SMAP L4 · 9 km regional context; right rail icons Source, Ask, Add to sheet, Share. Screen 03 PRE-DIAGNOSIS: a tag PRE-DIAGNOSIS · NOT A DIAGNOSIS, a serif headline Likely water stress with early aphid pressure, a confidence meter reading Medium confidence, and a line Confirm with your agronomist. Then three compact rotation rows: Current pea then lettuce; A add a legume; B green manure, one marked recommended. A short pest-care row: Release lacewings (Chrysoperla) · Trichoderma in compost. Bottom: a full-width button Export technical sheet (PDF) with a small note Every number cites its source.
